# fluent2_kit

> Flutter components, design tokens, and themes for Microsoft Fluent 2 mobile apps, with an iOS-first design intent and Material-based Flutter portability.

Use this package through public entrypoints only. Prefer `package:fluent2_kit/fluent2_kit.dart` for components and tokens, and `package:fluent2_kit/theme_data.dart` when using the built-in light/dark themes. Do not import from `lib/src`.

Important usage notes:
- Wrap the app with `FluentProvider` so banners, toasts, and Fluent scaffold behavior work.
- Use `FluentScaffold` when a screen needs Fluent banners, toasts, nav bars, or bottom-sheet behavior.
- Prefer Fluent widgets over Material widgets when this package has an equivalent.
- Style through `Fluent2ThemeData` and Fluent token classes such as `FluentColors`, `FluentSize`, `FluentCornerRadius`, `FluentShadow`, `FluentStrokeStyle`, `FluentStrokeThickness`, and Fluent typography styles.
- Avoid hardcoded colors, spacing, typography, radii, and Material-style affordances unless the package does not provide a Fluent equivalent.
